critique: The wordmark doesn't come from the mark: it opacity-fades in while sliding right, away from the mark, and at ~2.7s it sits nearly touching the still-moving mark. The mark's slide uses a soft Cubic In Out, so the payoff has no snap and doesn't land as 'the network connects, then speaks'. It also starts at frame 0 with no blank lead-in, and once drawn the network has no life of its own (no pulse along the lines, no settle on the dots).

Give the build one verb, 'connects': start with ~0.3s of empty frame. Pop the dots, then draw the lines. The moment the last line (B-D) closes, send a small pulse through the network, snap the mark left on an expo-out or spring, and reveal 'Mesh' from behind the mark under a mask in the same easing family. Finish with a small 4-6px settle and a clean hold.
